statement: Editable welcome-book/template tools fail to save or print, losing hosts' work.
desired_outcome: Produce a house manual without tool failures.
path: Editable welcome-book/template tools fail to save or print, losing hosts' work.

sources.title: 1-star review on an Airbnb welcome-book template (infleasy)
sources.text: Template could not be printed after personalizing and would not save. I lost hours of work.
